title: Implement user authentication via OAuth2
description: Set up OAuth2 login with Google and GitHub providers. Users should be able to sign in and receive a JWT session token.
architecture_notes: OAuth2 flow uses existing API gateway.

title: Add AI-powered product recommendation engine
description: Integrate an LLM-based recommendation engine that suggests products to users based on browsing history and purchase patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendations appear on product pages and homepage for logged-in users.

title: Database schema migration for user profiles v2
description: Migrate user_profiles table to a new schema that supports multi-tenancy. This involves altering 3 tables and updating 12 service endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Migration script runs without errors on staging. All existing user data preserved. API endpoints return correct responses after migration.
qa_notes: Run integration tests on staging after migration.

title: Fix typo in About page hero text
description: Correct spelling error: 'We buld' should be 'We build' in the About page hero section.
acceptance_criteria: The word 'buld' is corrected to 'build' in the About page hero text. Verified in staging environment.
qa_notes: Visual verification on staging. Check on mobile and desktop viewports.

title: Implement payment processing integration with Stripe
description: Integrate Stripe payment gateway for subscription billing. Handle credit card tokenization, webhook events, and failed payment retries.

title: Add unit tests for order service business logic
description: Write pytest unit tests for the order service: order creation, cancellation, status transitions, and discount calculation logic.
acceptance_criteria: Test coverage for order service reaches 85%. All tests pass in CI. Edge cases covered: empty order, invalid discount, concurrent status update.
qa_notes: Run pytest with coverage report. Validate CI pipeline passes. Review edge cases with QA engineer.

title: Deploy Sprint 4 release to production
description: Deploy.

title: Implement GDPR data deletion endpoint
description: Build a REST endpoint that allows users to request deletion of all their personal data (right to erasure). Must comply with GDPR Article 17.
acceptance_criteria: DELETE /api/v1/users/{id}/data endpoint returns 200 on success. All PII removed from database and S3. Deletion event logged to audit trail.
qa_notes: Test with real user data on staging. Verify S3 cleanup. Verify audit log entry.

title: Refactor legacy REST API endpoints to GraphQL
description: Refactor the 15 legacy REST endpoints in the user service to a GraphQL schema. Depends on TASK-003 schema migration being completed first.
acceptance_criteria: All 15 REST endpoints replaced with equivalent GraphQL queries and mutations. API documentation updated. Client SDKs updated.
security_notes: GraphQL depth limiting and query complexity analysis required.
qa_notes: Full regression test suite on new GraphQL API. Compare response parity with old REST endpoints.

title: Add rate limiting to public API gateway
description: Implement rate limiting on the public API gateway using a token bucket algorithm. Limit: 100 requests per minute per API key.
acceptance_criteria: API returns 429 when limit exceeded. Rate limit headers included in all responses. Limits configurable per tier.
security_notes: Rate limit headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining. Bypass testing performed. No auth token exposed in logs.
architecture_notes: Uses existing Redis cache layer for token bucket state.
qa_notes: Load test with 150 req/min to verify 429 response. Test header values. Test per-tier limits.

title: Build admin dashboard for user account management
description: Create an internal admin dashboard allowing support staff to view, update, suspend, and delete user accounts. Access restricted to admin role.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can search users by email. Admin can suspend/unsuspend accounts. Admin can view account activity log. Access gated by ADMIN role.
security_notes: Role-based access control enforced via JWT claims.
architecture_notes: Dashboard uses existing admin API endpoints.

title: Implement CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
description: Set up full CI/CD pipeline: lint, test, build Docker images, push to ECR, and deploy to ECS on merge to main. Add staging deployment on PR.
acceptance_criteria: CI pipeline runs on every PR. Tests must pass before merge. Automatic deploy to staging on PR. Automatic deploy to production on main merge.
security_notes: GitHub secrets used for AWS credentials. No secrets in YAML.
qa_notes: Smoke test after each deployment. Rollback tested manually.

title: Add LLM-based content moderation for user comments
description: Use an LLM API to automatically moderate user-generated comments. Flag hate speech, spam, and NSFW content. Auto-hide flagged content pending human review.

title: Update password hashing from MD5 to bcrypt
description: Replace legacy MD5 password hashing with bcrypt (cost factor 12). Migrate existing password hashes on next user login using re-hash-on-login strategy.
acceptance_criteria: New passwords stored as bcrypt hash. Existing MD5 hashes migrated on first successful login. No user disruption during migration. Bcrypt cost factor set to 12.
security_notes: Bcrypt cost factor 12 selected after performance benchmarking. Re-hash-on-login strategy avoids forced password reset. Security review completed with CISO sign-off.
architecture_notes: No architecture changes — drop-in replacement in auth service.
qa_notes: Test login flow with old MD5 accounts. Test login with new bcrypt accounts. Verify no plaintext passwords in logs.

title: Design and implement search feature
description: Search.

title: Performance testing for checkout flow
description: Run load tests on the checkout flow to validate it handles 500 concurrent users. Identify bottlenecks and document findings.
acceptance_criteria: System handles 500 concurrent users with p95 latency under 2 seconds. No errors above 0.1% error rate. Performance report produced.
architecture_notes: No architecture changes — read-only load test.
qa_notes: Use k6 for load testing. Run 3 test scenarios: 100/300/500 concurrent users. Export results as CSV and HTML report.

title: Integrate third-party analytics SDK
description: Add Segment analytics SDK to track user events: page views, button clicks, and conversion funnel steps. Events sent to Segment workspace.
security_notes: No PII sent to Segment. User ID anonymized before sending.
architecture_notes: SDK loaded asynchronously to avoid blocking page render.
qa_notes: Verify events appear in Segment debugger. Check no PII in event payloads.

title: Implement data encryption at rest for user PII
description: Encrypt all PII fields in the database at rest using AES-256. Applies to: email, phone, address, and payment method fields. Requires key management integration.

title: Fix broken image loading on mobile product pages
description: Product page images fail to load on mobile Safari when the image URL contains spaces. The URL encoding is missing for filenames with spaces.
acceptance_criteria: Product images load correctly on iOS Safari. Image URLs with spaces are properly encoded. No regression on desktop browsers.
qa_notes: Test on iOS Safari 16+. Test with product images that have spaces in filenames. Run visual regression test on desktop.

title: Set up Kubernetes deployment for microservices
description: Migrate all microservices from docker-compose to Kubernetes. Set up EKS cluster, namespaces, deployments, services, and ingress rules.
